title: Because of: debido a and a raíz de

sections.title: What you already know
sections.content: You know the formal cause connectors *debido a* (“because of”) and *a raíz de* (“as a result of”) from B1 Unit 6. They link a cause to what followed, and they are common in history writing. Here they follow the chain that led Latin America into debt.

items.spanish: Debido a la subida del petróleo, los bancos acumularon mucho dinero.
items.english: Because of the rise in oil prices, the banks accumulated a lot of money.

items.spanish: A raíz de los préstamos fáciles, varios gobiernos se endeudaron.
items.english: As a result of the easy loans, several governments went into debt.

items.spanish: Debido a los intereses, la deuda costaba cada año más.
items.english: Because of the interest, the debt cost more every year.

items.spanish: Muchos países tuvieron problemas a raíz del aumento de las tasas de interés.
items.english: Many countries had problems as a result of the rise in interest rates.

sections.content: After *debido a* and *a raíz de* put a noun, never a verb: *debido a la deuda*, but *porque la deuda creció*. *A* + *el* becomes *al* (*debido al petróleo*) and *de* + *el* becomes *del* (*a raíz del aumento*). *A raíz de* often points to an event that started a change.
